Lines.b40e9cc6-5815-451c-e3f4-8c2881b498a9: Your control is improving. You resisted your urge well.
Lines.d12fe20b-cd40-80e4-ceb9-59253c14c848: It was foolish of us to hope that the skeleton would provide for his aberrant guests. He has always been vocal about his distaste of illithids.
Lines.c9b96741-cea2-5498-432a-62b1c9b02fc2: Fortunately, these wilds are littered with suitable meals. We will find something to eat on the way home.
Lines.454cd609-3219-b20b-f784-b39f8807d534: But for now - let us enjoy the rest of the party.
